data_fields.name: cueRuleTable
data_fields.donor_constant: ordered regex:file rules from the player's options (grep found no sound rules in settings/; the only example is in docs/options_guide.txt)

data_fields.name: ruleChoiceWhenSeveralMatch
data_fields.donor_constant: first match in code (sound.cc:58); guide says last (options_guide.txt:545)

data_fields.name: oneVoiceLimit
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 voice when one_SDL_sound_channel is set, default off

data_fields.name: holdFlagPerCue
data_fields.donor_constant: bool, ignored on the SDL path

best_idea: Route each typed combat or UI event key through one ordered cue table with an explicit first-or-last rule and an optional single voice, instead of matching text.
decision_why: Keep the ordered table, the explicit first-or-last choice and the single-voice cut; reject the regex-over-text trigger because sound must follow server-confirmed events, not log text; reject the hold flag unless it is built end to end.
acceptance: A client test sends a typed spell-memorise event through a table with two rules for one key and asserts the chosen rule under each setting, and that the single-voice option cuts the previous cue.
